caseName: Illinois ex rel. Canal Commissioners v. Pittsburgh, Fort Wayne & Chicago Railway Co.
caseNameFull: People of the State of Illinois, Suing by the Canal Commissioners, in Error v. Pittsburgh, Fort Wayne & Chicago Railway Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. William Ritchie and Mr. Samuel B. King for the plaintiffs in error. Mr. Timothy J. Scofield, Mr. Frank J. Loesch, Mr. Charles F. Loesch and Mr. James Stillwell for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Eustis v. Bolles, 150 U. S. 361; Leathe v. Thomas, 207 U. S. 93; Yazoo & Miss. R. R. v. Brewer, 231 U. S. 245, 249; Holden Land Co. v. Interstate Trading Co., 233 U. S. 536, 541.
